contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ DN GRATIANVS AVGG AVG ; R/ GLORIA NOVI SAECVLI

A copper-alloy nummus of Gratian. Mint is Arles, 367-375, Reece period 19. Obverse shows Pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads DN GRATIANVS AVGG AVG. Reverse shows Emperor right with standard and shield. Reverse legend reads GLORIA NOVI SAECVLI. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //TCON. Die axis is 6 o'clock, weight is 2.31g, diameter is 16.74mm.
